subject: Request: Account stabilization credit proposal and short-term capacity for Vertex Health
messages:
From: Andre Silva <andre@vertexhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vertexhealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency/availability hits - impact to Vertex Health - request for remediation & credit

Karthik / Lauren,

We experienced repeated high-latency spikes and partial availability loss on Redwood's hosted inference endpoints that power our clinical triage flow between 2027-05-09 22:30 PDT and 2027-05-10 03:45 PDT. During the window: 3rd-party monitoring shows ~18% of requests timed out and median latency climbed from ~120ms to ~2.1s for critical inference calls. This materially increased queueing in our service and led to patient-routing delays that we logged as P2 impacts.

We raised a support ticket earlier and attached a short packet of logs (incident_logs_20270509.zip) with trace ids and sample requests. Our procurement team also asked us to open a conversation about a goodwill remediation (billing credit, temporary capacity, or both) while we evaluate longer-term resiliency.

Can you confirm what remediation Redwood can offer? Specifically we need:
- A one-off financial remediation (credit or free usage) to cover our customer SLA exposure for May.
- Short-term capacity guarantee (e.g., reserved burst for 2 weeks) while we review model routing and retry behavior.

We are available for a call today between 10:30–12:30 PDT.

Thanks,
Andre Silva\Head of Platform Engineering\Vertex Health
andre@vertexhealth.com
procurement@vertexhealth.com
(Attachment: incident_logs_20270509.zip — logs/trace snippets)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Andre Silva <andre@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency/availability hits - impact to Vertex Health - request for remediation & credit

Andre — thanks for the quick report and the logs. I'm really sorry for the impact this caused Vertex Health; this falls short of the experience we aim to deliver.

We have our infra team actively investigating the root cause (initial signal points to an autoscaling/queueing interaction under a burst of long-context requests). Jonas is on the ticket and will share a technical summary after the postmortem.

To get you an immediate remediation answer, here are three options we can execute as a one-off, subject to internal approval:

Option A — Billing credit: 25% credit on May usage for the affected endpoints (applies to hosted inference tokens only).
Option B — Account stabilization package: two weeks of reserved burst capacity (Dedicated burst, no charge) + 15% invoice credit for May services (capped at $12,000).
Option C — SLA service credit per contract: apply service-credit formula from SLA (we can calculate exact dollar value from the outage window).

We recommend Option B as it addresses both immediate capacity needs and provides credit for customer impact. I've attached a short calc (proposed_credit_calc_20270510.xlsx) showing capped exposure and back-of-envelope cost. If you'd like, we'll schedule a 30-minute call today at 11:00 PDT to confirm scope and the deliverables for the two-week burst.

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 08:12 AM Andre Silva <andre@vertexhealth.com> wrote:
> Karthik / Lauren,
> 
> We experienced repeated high-latency spikes...
> (see attached incident_logs_20270509.zip)

Regards,
Karthik Iyer\Head of Sales Engineering\Redwood Inference\karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(Attachment: proposed_credit_calc_20270510.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: INTERNAL — exec approval needed: stabilization package for Vertex Health (DEAL-4821)

Team — forwarding the customer request and my proposed options. Need quick exec approval to proceed with customer-facing commitment. Summary and recommendation below: 

Customer: Vertex Health (large, strategic healthcare account; procurement looped).
Impact: ~18% timed-out requests during a 5-hour window on 2027-05-09/10. They reported operational impact to clinical triage workflows.

Recommended remediation (my pick): Option B (Account stabilization package):
- Two weeks of reserved burst capacity (Dedicated burst capacity provisioned for their account; expected cost to us for the 2-week window: ~$5,500).
- 15% invoice credit applied to May invoice (estimated cost to us: capped at $12,000; credit to be issued as a one-line billing adjustment).
- Commit to a technical remediation postmortem within 72 hours and a follow-up architecture session to propose longer-term routing changes.

Rationale: Balances immediate operational relief with a reasonable goodwill credit; protects the relationship and reduces escalation risk.

Needed: Lauren — sign-off to approve a one-off credit + free burst. Marissa/Finance — confirm billing workflow for issuing credit and whether we require a contract amendment or a simple invoice adjustment. Jonas — scope for provisioning Dedicated burst (how quickly can we stand this up?).

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc_20270510.xlsx (cost + cap details).

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering\Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Andre Silva <andre@vertexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL — exec approval needed: stabilization package for Vertex Health (DEAL-4821)

Thanks for the clear recommendation, Karthik. Approved.

Please proceed with Option B as outlined:
- Provision the two-week Dedicated burst capacity today (standby window: 48–72 hours to confirm IPs/route). Jonas, coordinate with infra and notify both the customer and CS when capacity is live.
- Issue a 15% one-time credit for May, capped at $12,000, processed as a billing adjustment on the next invoice. Marissa, please confirm the journal entry and send the credit memo to Vertex Procurement once processed.
- Prepare a brief postmortem (technical + timeline) within 72 hours and schedule the architecture session within 10 business days.

Karthik — finalize the customer note (I included Andre on this thread). Keep tone apologetic, clear on the remediation steps, and give dates for the burst and postmortem deliverable. Also include the HubSpot deal id (DEAL-4821) in all records.

Andre — we're committed to making this right; we will follow up with timing for the Dedicated burst and an invoice credit memo.

Lauren Bishop\VP, Sales\Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
(Internal note: route DocuSign amendment only if Vertex requests a written amendment; otherwise process credit as a goodwill invoice adjustment.)
